brief: Clear encroaching vegetation and obstructions before the forecast heat event, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a ventilation defect is outstanding [SOP-011]. Regarding the oil issue, the supplied documents do not cover guidance for addressing this specific defect. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
